compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: A distribution complaint between language groups prompts the Twelve to distinguish responsibilities, the community chooses seven reputable men, and the word and number of disciples increase.
observations.label: A complaint leads to Spirit-and-wisdom service

observations.body: The passage presents Complaining, choosing, appointing, praying, and serving as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Complaining, choosing, appointing, praying, and serving

observations.body: The passage places Hellenists, Hebrews, Twelve, seven, widows, and priests beside Complaining, choosing, appointing, praying, and serving.
observations.label: Hellenists, Hebrews, Twelve, seven, widows, and priests

payload.posture: Read Acts 6:1–7 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a distribution complaint between language groups prompts the Twelve to distinguish responsibilities, the community chooses seven reputable men, and the word and number of disciples increase. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: A complaint leads to Spirit-and-wisdom service
